newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Malaysian rubber market is closed from February 6 to February 11 for the twin festivals of Chinese Lunar New Year and Moslem Eid al-Fitr.
Last Wednesday, prices closed higher on short-covering from Europe and Australia ahead of the long holidays, traders said.
March RSS1 buyer was quoted by the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board at 302 cents ($1.21) a kg, up two cents from Tuesday. March SMR 20 buyer was also up two cents at 297 cents.
